panels.description: Publisher database, configured instance, detected server endpoint, and PostgreSQL version.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag_data->>'database' AS database, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS configured_instance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tag_data->>'server_address', '') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE tag_data->>'server_address' || COALESCE(':' || NULLIF(tag_data->>'server_port', ''), '') END AS server_endpoint, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'pg_version', ''), 'unknown') AS postgres_version FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Source

panels.description: Subscriber database, configured instance, detected server endpoint, and PostgreSQL version.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag_data->>'database' AS database, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS configured_instance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tag_data->>'server_address', '') = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE tag_data->>'server_address' || COALESCE(':' || NULLIF(tag_data->>'server_port', ''), '') END AS server_endpoint, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'pg_version', ''), 'unknown') AS postgres_version FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$target' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Target

panels.description: HEALTHY requires fresh active/streaming slot data, a running apply worker, all tables ready, zero lag, and no new apply/sync errors in five minutes.

targets.rawSql: WITH slot_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'active')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS active, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS streaming, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS lag_bytes FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), subscription_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'enabled')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS enabled, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'subscription_status')::int, -1) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS subscription_status, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'apply_worker_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS apply_workers FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_points AS (SELECT time, COALESCE((data->>'apply_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS apply_errors, COALESCE((data->>'sync_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS sync_errors, COALESCE((data->>'stats_reset_epoch_s')::double precision, 0) AS reset_epoch FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_changes AS (SELECT time, reset_epoch, greatest(apply_errors - lag(apply_errors) OVER error_order, 0) + greatest(sync_errors - lag(sync_errors) OVER error_order, 0) AS new_errors FROM error_points WINDOW error_order AS (ORDER BY time)), error_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, COALESCE(sum(new_errors), 0)::bigint AS new_errors, COALESCE(min(reset_epoch) = max(reset_epoch), false) AS reset_stable FROM error_changes), table_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'total_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS total_tables, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS non_ready_tables FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes') SELECT CASE WHEN s.latest IS NULL OR sub.latest IS NULL OR e.latest IS NULL OR t.latest IS NULL OR s.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR sub.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR e.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR t.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 3 WHEN s.active <> 1 OR s.streaming < 1 OR sub.enabled <> 1 OR sub.subscription_status <> 1 OR sub.apply_workers < 1 OR t.total_tables < 1 OR t.non_ready_tables > 0 OR e.new_errors > 5 THEN 2 WHEN s.lag_bytes > 0 OR e.new_errors > 0 OR NOT e.reset_stable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS health, e.new_errors AS errors_last_5m FROM slot_state s CROSS JOIN subscription_state sub CROSS JOIN error_state e CROSS JOIN table_state t

panels.title: Replication health

panels.description: READY: replication is caught up and the data check passed. WARNING: lag, a few new errors, or reset error stats need review. NOT READY: replication or table sync is unhealthy, or over five new errors occurred. DATA CHECK REQUIRED: no check is recorded. DATA CHECK FAILED: the latest check did not pass. UNKNOWN: monitoring data is missing or old.

targets.rawSql: WITH slot_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'active')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS active, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS streaming, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS lag_bytes FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), subscription_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'enabled')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS enabled, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'subscription_status')::int, -1) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS subscription_status, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'apply_worker_count')::int, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS apply_workers FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_points AS (SELECT time, COALESCE((data->>'apply_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS apply_errors, COALESCE((data->>'sync_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS sync_errors, COALESCE((data->>'stats_reset_epoch_s')::double precision, 0) AS reset_epoch FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), error_changes AS (SELECT time, reset_epoch, greatest(apply_errors - lag(apply_errors) OVER error_order, 0) + greatest(sync_errors - lag(sync_errors) OVER error_order, 0) AS new_errors FROM error_points WINDOW error_order AS (ORDER BY time)), error_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, COALESCE(sum(new_errors), 0)::bigint AS new_errors, COALESCE(min(reset_epoch) = max(reset_epoch), false) AS reset_stable FROM error_changes), table_state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'total_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS total_tables, (array_agg(COALESCE((data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint, 0) ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS non_ready_tables FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'), pair_state AS (SELECT tag_data->>'migration_pair' AS migration_pair FROM general_database WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), validation_state AS (SELECT status FROM cutover_validation WHERE migration_pair = (SELECT migration_pair FROM pair_state) ORDER BY validated_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN s.latest IS NULL OR sub.latest IS NULL OR e.latest IS NULL OR t.latest IS NULL OR s.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR sub.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR e.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' OR t.latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 4 WHEN s.active <> 1 OR s.streaming < 1 OR sub.enabled <> 1 OR sub.subscription_status <> 1 OR sub.apply_workers < 1 OR t.total_tables < 1 OR t.non_ready_tables > 0 OR e.new_errors > 5 THEN 2 WHEN s.lag_bytes > 0 OR e.new_errors > 0 OR NOT e.reset_stable THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT status FROM validation_state) IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT status FROM validation_state) <> 'PASS' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS cutover_status FROM slot_state s CROSS JOIN subscription_state sub CROSS JOIN error_state e CROSS JOIN table_state t

panels.title: Cutover status

panels.description: Whether the selected publisher logical replication slot currently has an active consumer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->>'active')::int AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Slot active

panels.description: FLOWING means the subscriber acknowledged newer slot WAL within 60 seconds; IDLE means no LSN change, which is normal without writes. DISCONNECTED means the slot is inactive or not streaming. This does not prove application rows changed.

targets.rawSql: WITH samples AS (SELECT time, (data->>'active')::int AS active, (data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int AS streaming, NULLIF(data->>'confirmed_flush_lsn', '') AS confirmed_lsn FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds'), state AS (SELECT max(time) AS latest, (array_agg(active ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS active, (array_agg(streaming ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS streaming, count(*) FILTER (WHERE time > now() - interval '60 seconds') AS sample_count, count(DISTINCT confirmed_lsn) FILTER (WHERE time > now() - interval '60 seconds') AS lsn_count FROM samples) SELECT CASE WHEN latest IS NULL OR latest < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 3 WHEN active <> 1 OR streaming <> 1 THEN 2 WHEN sample_count < 2 OR lsn_count = 0 THEN 3 WHEN lsn_count > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS value FROM state

panels.title: Data flow

panels.description: Whether the selected subscription is running, disabled, or missing its apply worker.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->>'subscription_status')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Subscription status

panels.description: Number of active apply workers for the selected subscription.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->>'apply_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Apply worker count

panels.description: Number of active initial table synchronization workers for the selected subscription.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->>'table_sync_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Table sync worker count

panels.description: Publisher WAL bytes between its current write LSN and the slot's confirmed flush LSN; zero alone does not prove data equality.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS time, (data->>'lag_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Lag (bytes)

panels.description: Seconds since the subscriber last received a replication message; rising age can indicate a stalled connection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND tag_data->>'worker_type' = 'apply' ORDER BY time

panels.description: Publisher WAL bytes retained since the selected slot's restart LSN.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS time, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$source' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Retained WAL bytes over time

panels.description: Cumulative apply errors reported by the selected subscription; increases indicate new failures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS time, (data->>'apply_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Apply error count over time

panels.description: Cumulative table synchronization errors reported by the selected subscription.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS time, (data->>'sync_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sync error count over time

panels.description: Publisher publications and table counts, matched against the subscription's publication list.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_subscription AS (SELECT tag_data->>'publications' AS publications FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), wanted AS (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(publications, '[]')::jsonb) AS publication FROM latest_subscription), latest_publications AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'publication') time, tag_data, data FROM source_publication WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY tag_data->>'publication', time DESC) SELECT wanted.publication, CASE WHEN publication.tag_data IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'CONFIGURED' END AS status, publication.tag_data->>'owner' AS owner, COALESCE((publication.data->>'table_count')::bigint, 0) AS tables, COALESCE((publication.data->>'all_tables')::int, 0) AS all_tables, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_insert')::int, 0) AS inserts, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_update')::int, 0) AS updates, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_delete')::int, 0) AS deletes, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_truncate')::int, 0) AS truncates FROM wanted LEFT JOIN latest_publications AS publication ON publication.tag_data->>'publication' = wanted.publication ORDER BY wanted.publication

panels.title: Publication status

panels.description: Latest synchronization state for each table in the selected subscription; READY tables have finished synchronization.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'schema', tag_data->>'table') time, tag_data, data FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY tag_data->>'schema', tag_data->>'table', time DESC) SELECT time, tag_data->>'schema' AS schema, tag_data->>'table' AS table_name, CASE WHEN (data->>'ready')::int = 1 THEN 'READY' ELSE upper(data->>'state_name') END AS status, data->>'synchronization_lsn' AS synchronization_lsn FROM latest ORDER BY status, schema, table_name

panels.title: Table status

panels.description: Latest publisher slot state, LSN positions, lag, retained WAL, and connected replication client.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'slot_name') time, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot_name, tag_data->>'database' AS database, (data->>'active')::int AS active, data->>'restart_lsn' AS restart_lsn, data->>'confirmed_flush_lsn' AS confirmed_flush_lsn, (data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint AS lag_bytes, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::bigint AS retained_wal_bytes, tag_data->>'wal_status' AS wal_status, data->>'safe_wal_size_bytes' AS safe_wal_size_bytes, tag_data->>'invalidation_reason' AS invalidation_reason, tag_data->>'replication_application' AS application, tag_data->>'replication_client_addr' AS client_addr, tag_data->>'replication_state' AS replication_state, (data->>'replication_pid')::bigint AS replication_pid, data->>'sent_lsn' AS sent_lsn, data->>'write_lsn' AS write_lsn, data->>'flush_lsn' AS flush_lsn, data->>'replay_lsn' AS replay_lsn FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$source' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY tag_data->>'slot_name', time DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, (data->>'ready_tables')::bigint AS ready_tables, (data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint AS non_ready_tables, (data->>'total_tables')::bigint AS total_tables, CASE WHEN (data->>'total_tables')::bigint > 0 AND (data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint = 0 THEN 'READY' ELSE 'NOT READY' END AS status, time AS sampled_at FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'worker_type' AS worker_type, (data->>'pid')::bigint AS pid, (data->>'leader_pid')::bigint AS leader_pid, tag_data->>'relation' AS relation, data->>'received_lsn' AS received_lsn, data->>'latest_end_lsn' AS latest_end_lsn, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_send_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_send_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_receipt_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_receipt_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'latest_end_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS latest_end_time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS message_age_seconds FROM target_subscription s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$target' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY worker_type, pid

panels.title: Target database size

panels.description: Each row is a database/slot relationship. Registered profiles without fresh metrics remain UNKNOWN. Select a database to load its detailed replication panels below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source_provider, source_instance, target_provider, target_instance,
  source_database, target_database, slot, subscription,
  health_status, cutover_status, lag_bytes, errors, tables_ready,
  data_validation, validated_at, publisher, subscriber
FROM (WITH inventory AS (
  SELECT profile_name, enabled, provider, instance, role, migration_pair,
         last_seen_in_registry
  FROM monitoring_profile_inventory
  WHERE retired_at IS NULL AND role IN ('publisher', 'subscriber')
), expected AS (
  SELECT p.profile_name AS publisher, t.profile_name AS subscriber,
         COALESCE(p.migration_pair, t.migration_pair) AS migration_pair,
         p.provider AS source_provider, p.instance AS source_instance,
         t.provider AS target_provider, t.instance AS target_instance,
         p.enabled AS source_enabled, t.enabled AS target_enabled,
         p.last_seen_in_registry AS source_registered,
         t.last_seen_in_registry AS target_registered
  FROM (SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE role = 'publisher') p
  FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE role = 'subscriber') t
    ON p.migration_pair = t.migration_pair AND p.migration_pair <> ''
), slot_window AS (
  SELECT time, dbname AS publisher, tag_data->>'migration_pair' AS migration_pair,
         tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot, tag_data->>'database' AS source_database,
         COALESCE((data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint, 0) AS lag_bytes,
         COALESCE((data->>'active')::int, 0) AS active,
         COALESCE((data->>'publisher_streaming_count')::int, 0) AS streaming
  FROM source_replication_slot WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
), slots AS (
  SELECT publisher, migration_pair, slot,
         (array_agg(source_database ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS source_database,
         (array_agg(lag_bytes ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS lag_bytes,
         min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen,
         bool_and(active = 1 AND streaming > 0) AS healthy,
         bool_and(lag_bytes = 0) AS lag_zero
  FROM slot_window GROUP BY publisher, migration_pair, slot
), subscription_window AS (
  SELECT time, dbname AS subscriber, tag_data->>'migration_pair' AS migration_pair,
         tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot,
         COALESCE((data->>'enabled')::int, 0) AS enabled,
         COALESCE((data->>'subscription_status')::int, -1) AS subscription_status,
         COALESCE((data->>'apply_worker_count')::int, 0) AS apply_workers
  FROM target_subscription WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
), subscriptions AS (
  SELECT subscriber, migration_pair, subscription, slot,
         min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen,
         bool_and(enabled = 1 AND subscription_status = 1 AND apply_workers > 0) AS healthy
  FROM subscription_window GROUP BY subscriber, migration_pair, subscription, slot
), error_points AS (
  SELECT time, dbname AS subscriber, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription,
         COALESCE((data->>'apply_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS apply_errors,
         COALESCE((data->>'sync_error_count')::bigint, 0) AS sync_errors,
         COALESCE((data->>'stats_reset_epoch_s')::double precision, 0) AS reset_epoch
  FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
), error_changes AS (
  SELECT *, greatest(apply_errors - lag(apply_errors) OVER error_order, 0)
              + greatest(sync_errors - lag(sync_errors) OVER error_order, 0) AS new_errors
  FROM error_points WINDOW error_order AS (PARTITION BY subscriber, subscription ORDER BY time)
), errors AS (
  SELECT subscriber, subscription, min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen,
         COALESCE(sum(new_errors), 0)::bigint AS new_errors,
         min(reset_epoch) = max(reset_epoch) AS reset_stable
  FROM error_changes GROUP BY subscriber, subscription
), table_window AS (
  SELECT time, dbname AS subscriber, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription,
         COALESCE((data->>'total_tables')::bigint, 0) AS total_tables,
         COALESCE((data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint, 0) AS non_ready_tables
  FROM target_table_sync WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
), tables AS (
  SELECT subscriber, subscription,
         (array_agg(total_tables ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS total_tables,
         (array_agg(non_ready_tables ORDER BY time DESC))[1] AS non_ready_tables,
         min(time) AS first_seen, max(time) AS last_seen,
         bool_and(total_tables > 0 AND non_ready_tables = 0) AS healthy
  FROM table_window GROUP BY subscriber, subscription
), validations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (migration_pair) migration_pair, status, validated_at
  FROM cutover_validation ORDER BY migration_pair, validated_at DESC
), databases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dbname) dbname AS profile,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'database', ''), dbname) AS database
  FROM general_database WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  ORDER BY dbname, time DESC
), relationships AS (
  SELECT x.*, sub.subscription, sub.slot, sub.first_seen AS target_first_seen,
         sub.last_seen AS target_last_seen, sub.healthy AS target_healthy,
         s.source_database, s.lag_bytes, s.first_seen AS source_first_seen,
         s.last_seen AS source_last_seen, s.healthy AS source_healthy, s.lag_zero
  FROM expected x
  LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub ON sub.subscriber = x.subscriber AND sub.migration_pair = x.migration_pair
  LEFT JOIN slots s ON s.publisher = x.publisher AND s.migration_pair = x.migration_pair AND s.slot = sub.slot
), status_inputs AS (
  SELECT r.*, COALESCE(r.source_database, sd.database, r.publisher, '—') AS source_database_name,
         COALESCE(td.database, r.subscriber, '—') AS target_database_name,
         e.new_errors, e.reset_stable, e.first_seen AS error_first_seen,
         e.last_seen AS error_last_seen, t.total_tables, t.non_ready_tables,
         t.healthy AS tables_healthy, t.first_seen AS tables_first_seen,
         t.last_seen AS tables_last_seen, v.status AS data_validation, v.validated_at,
         (r.publisher IS NULL OR r.subscriber IS NULL OR r.subscription IS NULL
          OR (SELECT count(*) FROM inventory i WHERE i.role = 'publisher'
              AND i.migration_pair = r.migration_pair) <> 1
          OR (SELECT count(*) FROM subscriptions candidate
              WHERE candidate.migration_pair = r.migration_pair
                AND candidate.slot = r.slot) > 1
          OR r.source_provider IS NULL OR r.source_instance IS NULL
          OR r.target_provider IS NULL OR r.target_instance IS NULL
          OR r.source_registered < now() - interval '120 seconds'
          OR r.target_registered < now() - interval '120 seconds'
          OR r.source_last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds'
          OR r.target_last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds'
          OR e.last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds'
          OR t.last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds'
          OR r.source_last_seen IS NULL OR r.target_last_seen IS NULL
          OR e.last_seen IS NULL OR t.last_seen IS NULL) AS missing_or_stale,
         (r.source_first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes'
          OR r.target_first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes'
          OR e.first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes'
          OR t.first_seen > now() - interval '4 minutes') AS window_too_new
  FROM relationships r
  LEFT JOIN errors e ON e.subscriber = r.subscriber AND e.subscription = r.subscription
  LEFT JOIN tables t ON t.subscriber = r.subscriber AND t.subscription = r.subscription
  LEFT JOIN validations v ON v.migration_pair = r.migration_pair
  LEFT JOIN databases sd ON sd.profile = r.publisher
  LEFT JOIN databases td ON td.profile = r.subscriber
), status AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN missing_or_stale OR NOT COALESCE(source_enabled, false)
                   OR NOT COALESCE(target_enabled, false) THEN 'UNKNOWN'
         WHEN NOT source_healthy OR NOT target_healthy OR NOT tables_healthy
                   OR new_errors > 5 THEN 'CRITICAL'
         WHEN NOT lag_zero OR new_errors > 0 OR NOT reset_stable THEN 'WARNING'
         ELSE 'HEALTHY' END AS health_status,
    CASE WHEN missing_or_stale OR window_too_new
                   OR NOT COALESCE(source_enabled, false)
                   OR NOT COALESCE(target_enabled, false) THEN 'UNKNOWN'
         WHEN NOT source_healthy OR NOT target_healthy OR NOT tables_healthy
                   OR new_errors > 5 THEN 'NOT READY'
         WHEN NOT lag_zero OR new_errors > 0 OR NOT reset_stable THEN 'WARNING'
         WHEN data_validation IS NULL THEN 'DATA CHECK REQUIRED'
         WHEN data_validation <> 'PASS' THEN 'NOT READY'
         ELSE 'READY' END AS cutover_status
  FROM status_inputs
)
SELECT COALESCE(source_provider, '—') AS source_provider,
       COALESCE(source_instance, publisher, '—') AS source_instance,
       COALESCE(target_provider, '—') AS target_provider,
       COALESCE(target_instance, subscriber, '—') AS target_instance,
       source_database_name AS source_database, target_database_name AS target_database,
       publisher, subscriber, migration_pair, slot, subscription,
       lag_bytes, new_errors AS errors,
       CASE WHEN tables_last_seen IS NULL OR tables_last_seen < now() - interval '90 seconds'
                 THEN 'UNKNOWN'
            WHEN total_tables > 0 AND non_ready_tables = 0 THEN 'YES'
            ELSE 'NO' END AS tables_ready,
       health_status, cutover_status, data_validation, validated_at
FROM status
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(provider, '—'), COALESCE(instance, profile_name), '—', '—',
       profile_name, '—', profile_name, NULL, migration_pair, NULL, NULL,
       NULL, NULL, 'UNKNOWN', 'UNKNOWN', 'UNKNOWN', NULL, NULL
FROM monitoring_profile_inventory
WHERE retired_at IS NULL AND (role IS NULL OR role NOT IN ('publisher', 'subscriber'))) AS relationships
WHERE (${source_provider:sqlstring} = '' OR source_provider = ${source_provider:sqlstring})
  AND (${source_instance:sqlstring} = '' OR source_instance = ${source_instance:sqlstring})
  AND (${target_provider:sqlstring} = '' OR target_provider = ${target_provider:sqlstring})
  AND (${target_instance:sqlstring} = '' OR target_instance = ${target_instance:sqlstring})
ORDER BY CASE cutover_status WHEN 'NOT READY' THEN 0 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1
  WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 WHEN 'DATA CHECK REQUIRED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  source_database, target_database, slot

panels.title: Database migrations in this instance pair

list.label: Source
list.name: source
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(d.database, i.profile_name) || ' — ' || i.profile_name AS __text, i.profile_name AS __value FROM monitoring_profile_inventory i LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'database', ''), dbname) AS database FROM general_database WHERE dbname = i.profile_name AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) d ON true WHERE i.retired_at IS NULL AND i.role = 'publisher' AND (${source_provider:sqlstring} = '' OR i.provider = ${source_provider:sqlstring}) AND (${source_instance:sqlstring} = '' OR i.instance = ${source_instance:sqlstring}) ORDER BY __text

list.label: Target
list.name: target
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(d.database, i.profile_name) || ' — ' || i.profile_name AS __text, i.profile_name AS __value FROM monitoring_profile_inventory i LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'database', ''), dbname) AS database FROM general_database WHERE dbname = i.profile_name AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) d ON true WHERE i.retired_at IS NULL AND i.role = 'subscriber' AND i.migration_pair = (SELECT migration_pair FROM monitoring_profile_inventory WHERE profile_name = ${source:sqlstring}) AND (${target_provider:sqlstring} = '' OR i.provider = ${target_provider:sqlstring}) AND (${target_instance:sqlstring} = '' OR i.instance = ${target_instance:sqlstring}) ORDER BY __text

list.label: Slot
list.name: slot
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag_data->>'slot_name' AS __text, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS __value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = ${target:sqlstring} AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY 1

list.label: Subscription
list.name: subscription
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag_data->>'subscription' AS __text, tag_data->>'subscription' AS __value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = ${target:sqlstring} AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = ${slot:sqlstring} AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY 1
